candidates.title: Palazzo Massimo alle Terme (National Roman Museum)
candidates.summary: Superb Roman frescoes (Villa of Livia garden room), mosaics and bronzes in a calm, lift-equipped museum away from the famous crowds; ideal for a slow morning in one place. Step-free access route and handrail details should be confirmed directly.

candidates.title: Galleria Borghese: Caravaggio and Bernini
candidates.summary: A compact collection of Caravaggio paintings and Bernini sculpture, visited in timed slots that keep it uncrowded. Entry is by advance timed reservation; lift availability and the first entry slot time were not checked against their no-before-09:00 rule.

candidates.title: Galleria Doria Pamphilj
candidates.summary: A private princely palace with Caravaggio, Velázquez's Innocent X and room after room of Baroque painting, hung as a family collection. Self-guided with an audio guide; stair and lift access not verified.

candidates.title: Palazzo Barberini (Gallerie Nazionali)
candidates.summary: Caravaggio's Judith, Raphael's Fornarina and Pietro da Cortona's vast ceiling fresco in a Baroque palace; relaxed and rarely crowded. Note Borromini's oval stair; whether a lift serves all rooms was not checked.

candidates.title: Capitoline Museums
candidates.summary: The original Marcus Aurelius, the Capitoline Wolf and a view over the Forum from the Tabularium, plus Caravaggio in the picture gallery. Approach via the Cordonata ramp or road side rather than steep steps; internal lifts not verified.

candidates.title: Centrale Montemartini
candidates.summary: Roman sculpture displayed among the turbines of an old power station: quiet, flat and unusual, and new since their last visit. Accessibility details not checked.

candidates.title: Mercato Testaccio
candidates.summary: A covered, flat-floored neighbourhood food market with produce stalls and lunch counters; easy walking with no cobbles inside. Opening days and hours not verified.

candidates.title: Crypta Balbi (National Roman Museum)
candidates.summary: Layers of a Roman theatre complex through to medieval Rome, explained in place; small and absorbing. Current opening status and access to the underground levels (stairs, handrails) were not checked, so confirm before relying on it.

candidatesAccepted.title: Hotel with a lift in Prati, near Ottaviano metro
candidatesAccepted.summary: A kind of place, not a named premises: a mid-range hotel in Prati, where streets are wide, flat and mostly paved rather than cobbled, with the metro and buses close by. Ask for a lift, a handrail on any entrance steps, and a walk-in shower. Rooms likely run 150–260 CAD a night, which would take most of the 350 CAD daily budget. I could not tell whether that budget covers lodging, so check the split.

candidatesAccepted.title: Hotel with a lift on or near Via Nazionale
candidatesAccepted.summary: A kind of place, not a named premises: a hotel on the asphalt Via Nazionale or Monti side streets. It is close to Palazzo Massimo for Roman archaeology, buses run to the Forum area, and the Repubblica metro is nearby. Choose a hotel facing the main road rather than an uphill cobbled lane in Monti, and confirm a lift with step-free entry. Prices are a rough guess for October, when demand is high.

candidatesAccepted.title: Hotel near Piazza del Popolo or Via del Babuino
candidatesAccepted.summary: A kind of place, not a named premises: a hotel near Piazza del Popolo or Via del Babuino. Caravaggio's paintings in Santa Maria del Popolo and the Villa Borghese are walkable from here, mostly on paved rather than cobbled streets, and the Flaminio metro is nearby. Rooms here usually sit at or above the budget, so treat this as the upper end. Confirm a lift and a handrail on entrance steps.

candidatesAccepted.summary: An unhurried afternoon gelato is part of Roman life; choose one marked artigianale near wherever the morning ends. Dietary restrictions unknown.

candidatesAccepted.summary: A seated glass of wine with small plates in the early evening is a gentle way to close a slow day. Kind of place, no premises named; check step-free entry.

candidatesAccepted.summary: Canadians are expected to need an ETIAS authorisation for Schengen entry by 2027, but the launch date and fee have shifted repeatedly. Check the official EU site before travel; I cannot confirm it will be in force for October 2027. Also confirm passports are valid at least 3 months past 2027-10-16. This is not clearance to travel.

candidatesAccepted.summary: Provincial health plans cover little abroad, and premiums rise sharply at these ages, so compare policies with emergency medical, repatriation and trip-interruption cover. Declare pre-existing conditions accurately. I do not know your health history or any existing card or employer coverage, so this cost band is very rough.
